_about: Curated name -> US ticker aliases for name-only holdings rows (v0.4 A6), consulted before SEC's issuer names by scripts/resolve_tickers.py. Keys are matched after the normalisation in scripts/providers/names.py (casefold, punctuation and corporate-form words dropped), so 'Apple Inc.' and 'APPLE' both meet the key 'Apple'. An alias names an issuer, not a listing: for a foreign private issuer (TSMC, ASML, Arm) the row still needs an ADR marker or a US ISIN to be kept. Share classes are consolidated on purpose: Alphabet -> GOOGL, Berkshire Hathaway -> BRK.B. Claude may propose additions in the work directory's new_aliases.json; they are added here only after the maintainer reviews them, never automatically.
